sources.label: Morphe patches for Action app (Dark Mode)
sources.author: Action Dark Mode
patch_list: Forces dark mode throughout the Action app by overriding the core Jetpack Compose color palette and customer card QR code.
Forces dark window and splash screen backgrounds in styles.xml to eliminate the white flash on app startup.

Adds bidirectional sorting options with interactive chips for Weekly Deals, keeps native filtering/sorting untouched on 'New' and category pages, increases initial deals page limit to 120, and fixes badge label clipping.
